title: aster diffusus var. bifrons
intro: Aster diffusus var. bifrons, commonly known as White Aster or White Mountain Aster, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family, characterized by its white or pale pink flowers and tall, upright growth habit. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and other minor health issues. The therapeutic actions of White Aster include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a popular choice in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of Aster diffusus var. bifrons include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
